954799482d6fd54468b7a8d4e451a804cfd76401: A resort with a human scale, Scuol focuses on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than on impressive figures. Its 70 km of pistes are perfectly suited to a 3 to 4 day stay, especially for families or for skiers who don't need to constantly change their playground. Scuol's reputation as a family resort is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. With a summit at 2785 m and a village at 1250 m, Scuol's snow cover is generally reliable from January to the end of March. A few exceptionally mild winters can cause tension early in the season, but the situation recovers quickly with the first substantial snowfalls. The budget for a stay in Scuol is clearly high: 73€ for a day pass, plus accommodation and high-mountain restaurants among the most expensive in the Alps. It is the price of excellence, but you should be aware of it before you go. In short: Scuol keeps its promises. A resort in the Northern Alps that will suit most skier profiles without disappointing.

It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Präbichl's modest altitude, starting at 1,100 m and rising to 1,608 m, makes it sensitive to climate variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. The budget for a stay in Präbichl is clearly on the high side: 56€ for the day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps.
